DM Mariam's simple guide to dealing with messing up pronouns:
Oh shoot, you messed up another player's or character's pronouns/name! You want to respect them and try your best, but you accidently did the wrong thing!
Well I'm here to help. As a real life trans person (tm), I can give you my advice on this situation. 
1: apologize
The most important way to make sure someone knows you care about their pronouns is by making clear you know when you did wrong. If you didn't realize and someone else points it out, this step is still important.
2: say the phrase again
Practice makes perfect. And if you want to practice using the correct pronouns, there's no better way than re-doing the statement. Because if your brain knows not only that you made a mistake, but what the right thing to say was, it'll make it easier to get it right the next time.
If you typed out the mistake, please edit the message to use the correct pronouns.
3: don't make a big deal out of it.
I promise you, we want to move on just as much as you do. Acknowledging the mistake and moving on is all we need to hear to know you're working on it. Don't make it any more awkward then it needs to be.

That's it! Here's an example to help you understand what the steps mean. Let's say you're talking in out of character about something I mentioned yesterday that has implications for your character.

You: "Yeah, DM Mariam mentioned something yesterday about missing children posters in another Burrough. I wonder what he's trying to set up with that."
Someone else: "She."
You: "Oh my bad, sorry. I wonder what she's trying to set up with that."
Me: "You'll have to find out..."

And just like that, we've moved on and you've given your brain more practice! Easy!

This has been DM Mariam's simple guide to dealing with messing up pronouns.

It’s been 8 long years since the Boston Massacre. When we arrived on these shores as refugees from the wars of the Old World we found a haven. We were protected for a time by those gracious enough to lend their strength and friendship to allow us to settle along their eastern coast. Some of those who came were naturalists and inventors. Some were scholars and leaders. Together with the ingenuity of both the Old World and the New, there was a new renaissance of arcane invention. The methods of both worlds combined in surprising ways that changed our lives forever. Of all of the Old World, only England secured the rights of trade peacefully. Where the French sent troops to the north, and the Spanish sent troops to the south The English signed a treaty of mutual defence. We became dependent on their money. And they became dependent on the inventions and marvels of the New World. We traded away our governance for promises that England would protect us from the wars of the Old World.

Some said the wars were our fault. Gods that were dead awoke on our shores. They awoke and returned to the Old World with wrath on their minds. A barrier went up, to keep their strife from our homes. But the hundred years war still rages. And though the fighting hadn’t reached our shores, the Old World both needs and resents us. We have had the time and the resources to change the way life is lived. But where we saw scholars, they saw soldiers. We backed England to defend us. Now, they own us. Little by little their offers of help and protection meant accepting their leadership. And the Continental States became the Colonies of England. We gave it all up to keep out the French and the Spanish. But where saw a shield the English saw the means to shackle us.

Slowly they have built up their navies and left them on our shores and in our skies. Using our methods and inventions and their money, their troubles that we thought we were escaping never left our shores. Daily we are reminded of the threats they say they are facing on our behalf. They don’t ask for things anymore. They quarter their troops in our homes. They tax us for our “protection” and we don’t get a say in what happens. And then some of us had had enough, our protests were met with murder. How exactly, I ask you, are they protecting us with violence against us?

When unrest fomented into war, Master Mason Washington took the lead of a real defence. For two years his fight has spanned all thirteen of These United States. Now their influence converges on the capitol. That melting pot of races and refugees, Empire City is where it will culminate. The Red Coats walk our streets, live in our homes, run our factories, and continue aided and abetted by their loyalists. Washington himself has overtaken Governors’ island and built a fortress to defend the hudson. But I fear that a military campaign cannot defend a city if that city has already crumbled from within.

It will be up to those that live there to change the tides of war. If they cannot overcome their difference and rise against the red tide of manipulation and propaganda, the seat of our little empire will fall, and with it, I fear, the colonies and then the rest of the continent. We must congress together as one nation with one voice and vision. 

May Columbia’s guiding light wash away the blindness of our people.

Coney Island: large fairground at S of burrough. Entirely fairground/amusement park, including park areas
Spitside: Ferrytown area of spit protruding from Hampstead. East side of the area is home to several ports used for both legitimate and illegitimate shipping, while the west section is one of the wilder feywild bleed-overs and a part of the Grassy Bay Bleed.
Grassy Bay Bleed: The estuary-bay occupying the southeast coast of Ferrytown is home to large swaths of coastal feywild parks, many of which are islands. These parks are frequently used by smugglers to avoid watchful eyes, as it is exceedingly difficult to track a shipment that passes in and out of the feywild. The large swath near spitside is home to a large orchard.
The Bustle: A large market district in the center of Ferrytown that borders on and overlaps with several natural areas. If you want strange curios and other oddities, this is where you go. The shops are run by Seelie fey during the day and Unseelie fey during the night, meaning that different products may be available at different times.
Sunrise Port: Near the north end of Ferrytown and in full view of The City, the Sunrise Port is the main ferry port transporting between Ferrytown and The City, as well as up the channels to Kingsbridge.
Sunset Port: West of The Hilltops, the Sunset Port is the main ferry port transporting across the river from the Empire City.
Twilight Port: Just north of Coney Island, the Twilight Port is the main ferry port transporting between Ferrytown and the Staten Wastes.

The Hilltops: A stretch of hilly terrain near the center of Ferrytown, the East and West Hills are both places of feywild bleed over, though they are not connected. The most 'outsider friendly' of the feywild parks, they are adjacent to The Bustle and often full of younger teens and children, staying pleasantly warm for most of the day and year.
The Mounds: A major feywild park on the east edge of Ferrytown, the mostly flat but with small mounds of earth terrain of The Mounds makes it home to many fey who live under the small mounds. Its proximity to Hampstead and the associated gloom means it is a main dwelling place for Unseelie fey.
Risehall: Stretching taller than most other buildings in Ferrytown, this area between the Sunrise and Sunset ports is home to visitors accustomed to more built-up dwellings. It also houses a population of mostly elf traders who commute to The City from Ferrytown each day. 
Jameco: Named for the original human residents, Jameco is a community built primarily of these native peoples and fey bleed over. It is home to the Ferrytown court and resides between The Mounds and Grassy Bay.

**Paddy's Pub**
Situated on the south corner of the Western Hilltop park, this pub made of stone and wood is split down the middle and has two entrances: one on the feywild bleed side, and one that leads out into the more mundane section of The Bustle. There are no rules or firm divisions between the two sides, and mingling occurs frequently. Uncle Paddy is an older Kimellian man who speaks with a somewhat Irish accent. (Does this make sense? kinda, i guess?) Paddy is keen to offer advice to newcomers, as well as drinks and various potions. The drinks come in both alcoholic and non-alcoholic versions. One of the foods that is sold is a sugary grain cereal, marketed by someone who is in opposition to Kellog. To-go orders are allowed, but **all drinks bought at the pub will spoil the following dawn, becoming inert (albeit still alcoholic).**
The interior of the bar appears more slanted and uneven the more you approach the fey side, making it difficult not to spill your drink.

**Items Available:**
Airhead ale: This drink makes you feel light of both head and body. For the next hour, you levitate 5ft off of the ground at your walking speed, and descend at a rate of 5ft every 30ft if more than 5ft off of the ground. However, you find it hard to focus, and have disadvantage on saving throws to maintain concentration. 60gp.
Begger's Bottle: This drink allows you to use the "Grovel and Beg" racial feature of Kobolds once in the next hour. 130gp.
Banshee's Brew: This dark grey drink seems to wail mournfully at a low volume. When drunk, you can emit a mournful wail.
